books.central_question: Will Elin use Aurek's name to stop the flooding of the delta?
books.hinge: The Emperor holds a name too: Elin's, given to the river at her birth and taken from it. He speaks it and she kneels.

books.central_question: Can two people stay themselves inside one name?
books.hinge: The Emperor dies and his will leaves the Rolls, Elin's name among them, to Aurek.

books.central_question: Will Elin free every held name in the empire, including the one that binds them?
books.hinge: Series close: every name given to the open river, the River Compact begun; no open hinge (HEA).
